en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an extensive industrial brewery complex with multiple brick buildings, tall smoking chimneys, and adjacent railway tracks in a valley surrounded by rocky hills and trees. A smaller inset view at the bottom shows the same brewery and its grounds from another angle. Printed captions in German identify the site as the Felsenkeller brewery near Dresden, and the card has a narrow border with the printer's imprint along the left side.
